name: Corey Berg
title: Principal & Project Management
bio:
Corey Berg is a Partner at The Ritchie Group leading the Industrial Practice focused on bulk distribution, data center, manufacturing and self-storage projects. His day to day roles consist of working in the areas of site acquisition, site planning, construction management, feasibility studies and project management for various projects.

Corey graduated from Brigham Young University with a BS in Accounting. In his free time Corey loves boating with family and friends.
